about.title: About Irakee
about.missionDesc: To build the definitive digital ecosystem for the Iraqi diaspora — directory, marketplace, events, and mediation — owned by the community, not shareholders.
about.visionDesc: Every Iraqi abroad has a digital home where they can find community, opportunity, and connection to Iraq.
about.structureDesc: Irakee operates as a UK Community Interest Company (CIC), a non-profit legal entity specifically designed for community benefit. All profits are reinvested into the platform, not distributed to shareholders.
about.teamMember1Bio: Iraqi-British civil engineer building the Irakee platform to connect the Iraqi diaspora worldwide.
